interview.hardest_part: Completing Community Center bundles and restoring rooms requires multi-day planning, seasonal items, inventory management, and reliable navigation through menus and town/farm/mine locations.
interview.likely_failure: I will likely fail to complete the first bundle and therefore all room-restoration milestones; fishing and finding copper before the mines are reliably accessible are also likely stumbling points.
interview.helpful_mechanics: The deterministic day cycle, sleeping to save, early parsnip crop, free fishing rod availability, shops, map and quest journal, and the fixed Spring forage/crop requirements give a clear early-game path.
interview.harmful_mechanics: The 14-minute day limit and 2:00 am pass-out, energy constraints, fishing minigame, seasonal bundle requirements, 12-slot backpack, and screenshot-only navigation/UI make sustained multi-day planning difficult.
